text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright conquered the Arima Kinen, 
revealing a brand-new brilliance for the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Along the endless road leading to the 
summit, slowly... but surely, Mejiro 
Bright climbed upward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing as victor, Mejiro Bright spoke: 
about what belonged solely to Mejiro, what 
they had protected, and the new era born 
from their enduring tradition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through that shining brilliance, Mejiro 
Bright became the new beacon of admiration 
for the Mejiros—and all Umamusume.
